# CCMAPractice — NHA CCMA Exam Preparation
> AI-powered exam preparation for the NHA Certified Clinical Medical Assistant (CCMA) certification.
> 1,200+ practice questions, 13 theory chapters, AI tutor. Passing score 390/500 (150 scored + 30 pretest, 3 hours).
